$comment: S10b's confirmation record (confirmation.json): design §10.3's binding of the approval ids to F's configuration_sha and the confirmation manifest and results hashes, which is what S11 applies; plus the plan's confirmation_id (code-generated), confirm_version (the confirmation version the owner decided), decision_input_sha (the owner's copy's sha256, as S10's approvals carry it) and at. Release 1 runs no S8 (D-20261111-818391), so results_sha carries the named state 'untested: s8_deferred', never null (lead decision E2); manifest_sha is the sha256 of confirm/v<k>/manifest.json as S10b's build part recorded it.
title: S10b confirmation

results_sha.$comment: The confirmation's results hash; in release 1 the named state, since no S8 ran.
